items.title: 7.4 Stationary waves aur un ki banawat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.4 with Fig. 7.6 (PDF 146-147).

blocks.title: Stationary waves
blocks.text: Stationary waves, jinhein standing waves bhi kehte hain, woh waves hain jo baghair aage barhe ek muqarrar jagah par jhoolti hain. Yeh ulti simton mein chalti, ek hi frequency aur amplitude wali do waves ki superposition se banti hain. Nateeja wave pattern thehra rehta hai, jis mein nodes (sifar amplitude ke nuqte) aur antinodes (zyada se zyada amplitude ke nuqte) muqarrar jagahon par hote hain. Misalein: taar par waves aur pipe mein sound waves. Standing wave ka lafz batata hai ke pattern jagah mein thehra rehta hai, musbat aur manfi qeematon ke darmiyan jhoolta hai, aage ya peeche nahi barhta.

Taar par ulti simton mein chalti do waves ki superposition par ghaur karein. Figures 7.6(a) aur (b) aisi do waves ka profile lamhaat t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T par dikhate hain, jahan T wave ka time period hai. Hum in lamhaat par nuqton 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 aur 7 ke displacements dekhte hain jab waves superpose hoti hain; nuqte ek doosre se lambda/4 door hain, lambda wavelength hai, aur un ka nateeja displacement superposition ke usool se milta hai.

blocks.alt: t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T ke paanch kalam. Qatar (a): baen chalti magenta lehar (teer), qatar (b): daen chalti magenta lehar (teer), nuqte 1 se 7 tak dashed lakeeron par, chauthai wavelength ke faasle par. Qatar (c): nuqte 1, 3, 5, 7 har lamhe axis par, always at rest. Qatar (d): nuqte 2, 4, 6 displacement ke teeron ke sath, t = 0 aur T par 2, 6 oopar aur 4 neeche, T/2 par ulat, T/4 aur 3T/4 par koi nahi: always oscillating.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.6: Stationary / standing waves (kitab ki Figure 7.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har kalam mein (a) aur (b) ko jama karein. Nuqte 1, 3, 5, 7 par dono lehrein hamesha ek doosre ko khatam karti hain: yeh nodes hain. Nuqte 2, 4, 6 par t = 0 par dono crest hain (dugna displacement), T/4 par dono ka jor sifar, T/2 par dono trough: yeh antinodes hain jo sab se zyada jhoolte hain.

Figure 7.6(c) nuqton 1, 3, 5 aur 7 ka nateeja displacement lamhaat t = 0, T/4, T/2, 3T/4 aur T par dikhati hai: in nuqton ka nateeja displacement hamesha sifar hai, aur medium ke in nuqton ko nodes kehte hain. Do lagataar nodes ka faasla lambda/2 hai. Figure 7.6(d) nuqton 2, 4 aur 6 ko inhi lamhaat par dikhati hai: yeh nuqte ajza (component) waves ke amplitudes ke majmooe ke barabar amplitude se hilte hain aur antinodes kehlate hain. Yeh nodes ke beech mein hain aur ek doosre se lambda/2 door; node se agle antinode ka faasla lambda/4 hai. Nodes aur antinodes ka aisa pattern stationary ya standing wave hai.

Wave mein energy medium ke zarron ki harkat se muntaqil hoti hai. Nodes hamesha aaram mein rehte hain, to energy in nuqton se aage nahi beh sakti; lihaza energy medium mein nodes ke darmiyan thehri rehti hai, agarche antinodes par potential aur kinetic shakalon mein badalti rehti hai. Jab tamam antinodes apne intehai displacement par hon to jama energy poori potential hai, aur jab woh ek saath apni equilibrium position se guzrein to energy poori kinetic hai.

blocks.prompt: Kya taar par ek hi simt mein chalti do milti julti waves stationary wave bana sakti hain (short question 7.5)? Node aur antinode ki tareef kijiye (MCQ 7.3, 7.4, 7.5).
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Stationary wave ke liye ek hi frequency aur amplitude ki ulti simton mein chalti do waves chahiye, aam taur par ek wave aur us ka reflection; ek hi simt mein do milti julti waves bas mil kar bari chalti hui wave banati hain. Node sifar displacement ka nuqta hai, hamesha aaram mein; antinode zyada se zyada displacement ka nuqta hai, nodes ke beech mein; pattern muqarrar jagah par jhoolta hai.

items: Stationary (standing) wave: barabar frequency aur amplitude ki ulti simton mein chalti do waves; pattern thehra rehta hai. Nodes (sifar displacement) lambda/2 door; antinodes (zyada se zyada) beech mein, node se lambda/4. Energy nodes se aage nahi jati; antinodes par potential aur kinetic mein badalti hai.
